from AlgorithmImports import *

class ParallelTwoSlotStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_present = self.spy in data.Bars
        aapl_present = self.aapl in data.Bars

        if aapl_present:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        all_bars_present = all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols)

        fully_formed = (
            all_bars_present
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_ready
        )

        if fully_formed:
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )
            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )

            # Sells before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_present:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            self.previous_spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ParallelTwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                return
            bars[ticker] = data.bars[symbol]

        spy_bar = bars["SPY"]
        aapl_bar = bars["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma.update(spy_bar.end_time, spy_bar.close)
        self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_bar.close)

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if aapl_bar.close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        fully_formed = (
            self.spy_sma.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and self.spy_previous_sma is not None
            and self.aapl_previous_close is not None
        )

        if fully_formed:
            # Sells before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                and self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_bar.close < self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_bar.close > self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                target_value = self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40
                shares = int(target_value // spy_bar.close)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                    shares = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)

                    if shares > 0:
                        self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.close
        self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.close

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._update_market_state(spy_close, aapl_close)
            return

        spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
            spy_crossed_below_sma = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < spy_sma_value
            )
            spy_crossed_above_sma = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > spy_sma_value
            )

            # Evaluate sells before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below_sma:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above_sma:
                target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
                quantity = int(target_value // spy_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                cash_amount = 20_000
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_amount:
                    quantity = int(cash_amount // aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_market_state(spy_close, aapl_close)

    def _update_market_state(self, spy_close, aapl_close):
        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
